messages:
Leah - CSM: Heads up: AuroraHealth onboarding had issues last Friday. p95 for /v1/generate jumped to ~1.6s and we saw ~14 minutes of degraded availability during their dedicated window. Need SLO calc + potential credit + enablement follow-up.
Tom - CS Ops: Oof. Do we have the per-account SLO window and minutes?
Maya - Solutions Eng: Looking now. Early signs point to excessive concurrent warmups + a cross-region fallback when the primary cluster hit load. Also saw larger-than-expected token lengths.
Leah - CSM: Customer said they followed the example script but didn't see the batching recommendation in onboarding. They ran with concurrency=50 for a soak test.
Ethan - RevOps: Contract uptime = 99.9% for onboarding SLA. If 14 minutes downtime is within their monthly window we may owe credits. Will need exact minutes below threshold.
Tom - CS Ops: OnboardBot created ticket INC-8801 and assigned to eng-runtime.
OnboardBot: Ticket INC-8801 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-8801
Maya - Solutions Eng: Quick per-account check I ran:
```
-- per-account SLO violations for onboarding window
SELECT account_id,
  SUM(downtime_minutes) as downtime_min,
  COUNTIF(type='latency' AND percentile='p95') as latency_violations
FROM account_slo_reports
WHERE account_id='aurora-health' AND window_start >= '2026-03-01' AND window_end <= '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY account_id;
```
Maya - Solutions Eng: Query result: downtime_min=14, latency_violations=5.
Ethan - RevOps: That 14m against their SL window (30d) crosses 99.9%? Quick calc: 30d = 43200 minutes; allowed downtime at 99.9% = ~43.2 minutes. So technically within SLA overall, but onboarding window policy says any >10m triggers onboarding credit review.
Leah - CSM: Good catch. So we should propose a one-off onboarding credit and a mitigations package: (1) enablement workshop, (2) onboarding doc update with explicit batch/concurrency guidance, (3) route pinning recommendation for critical endpoints.
Tom - CS Ops: Ops tasks: attach traces/Grafana, add fallback timeline, recommend runtime config changes (max-concurrency per account, soft-warmup). I'll add notes to INC-8801.
Maya - Solutions Eng: I'll build a short 20-25m deck for the enablement session covering batching, prefix/KV caching, and how to pin to low-latency model variants.
Ethan - RevOps: Credit calc template: we typically pro-rate onboarding credits: credit = (minutes_over_threshold / minutes_in_window) * monthly_fee * onboarding_credit_factor. I'll draft numbers once Tom confirms exact minutes in the account window.
Leah - CSM: I'll draft the customer note with timeline + proposed credit and include a short SLO summary page (uptime, p50/p95, incident log). Will share here for review before sending.
OnboardBot: Reminder: follow up on INC-8801 in 72 hours.
Tom - CS Ops: Added Grafana panel links and traces to INC-8801, also uploaded a short timeline: primary cluster CPU surge -> region fallback at 15:12 -> degraded route until 15:26 -> recovery.
Maya - Solutions Eng: Added suggested config snippet for customers to limit concurrency and enable prefix warmup:
```
client.batch_size = 8
client.max_concurrency = 12
client.warmup_enabled = true
client.warmup_prefixes = ["/prompt/warmup/"]
```
Leah - CSM: I'll set renewal_exposure = 'watch' and ping AE. If we deliver a prompt credit + enablement quickly this should reduce churn risk.
Ethan - RevOps: Marked CRM record with onboarding_credit_pending. Once Leah posts the customer note I'll approve the credit calc and route to billing.
Leah - CSM: Internal action items: 1) Customer note + SLO one-pager (Leah, EOD+1), 2) Credit calculation + billing approval (Ethan, EOD+2), 3) Enablement deck + session scheduling (Maya, 48h), 4) Runtime traces + runbook updates (Tom, PR in repo).
Tom - CS Ops: Will open a runbook PR to include a short troubleshooting checklist for onboarding customers and add concurrency guardrails.
Maya - Solutions Eng: Also will prepare a follow-up feedback form for the customer to capture whether the batching guidance solved their issue.
Leah - CSM: Perfect. Once the credit is applied we'll include the feedback form link in the customer message and add a checklist item to onboarding docs to confirm customers received batching guidance. :white_check_mark:
Ethan - RevOps: Noted. Closing loop: billing will process credit after sign-off.
OnboardBot: Status update reminder set for 72 hours on INC-8801.
